summary: Lessons from publishing Wizard/Creator 0.22.0 (#4811). (1) The exact-source compatibility seal (SourceCompatibility.compatible) admits only progress-report additions, so any other main merge between candidate and publish invalidates the candidate, and every non-report merge before a release-route squash requires a reseal; publication therefore needs a main merge hold. (2) Preparation requires Authority main unchanged across journal classification, so concurrent ordinary settlement bursts can refuse a preflight without effect; dispatch after Authority has been stable. (3) The first 022 journal stranded: generation 2 recorded tag intent and both PATCHes succeeded, but the CAS did not complete its post-PATCH readback, and the engine treats intent plus absent as waiting forever, so existing-journal recovery cannot settle it. The evidence is consistent with read-after-write staleness rather than a failed GET (the 52/51 GET gap is the expected fresh-ref 404, also present in passing runs); the exact mechanism is unproven. The fix was a fresh journal identity (022r1) with the abandoned journal recorded as history; a bounded re-read of acknowledged writes is proposal (ii) on #4753. A bounded admission-read retry was added as hardening only.
title: Creator 0.22 publication: fresh-journal recovery from an unsent intent and its accepted boundary
